# Entrepreneurship & Innovation Centre Ltd

> ISO 9001:2015 certified Human Capital Development and Management Consultancy in Port Harcourt, Nigeria.

## About
E&I Centre provides entrepreneurship training, innovation consulting, capacity building, and startup support across the Niger Delta and Nigeria.
